releaseNotes: 按每套皮肤分别计算 Codex 正文、弱化文字、发送与停止控件颜色，关键对比度不低于 4.5:1；会话正文使用无边框连续阅读层；未声明字体时保留原生字体；发送状态只识别一个可见主操作按钮，并修复隐藏旧 Send、取消上传和暂停录音等误判。
releaseNotesEn: Computes Codex body, muted, send, and stop colors per skin with at least 4.5:1 contrast; adds a continuous borderless reading layer; preserves native fonts unless a skin explicitly declares one; and recognizes only one visible primary submit action while avoiding stale Send, cancel-upload, and pause-recording false positives.
